required_elements.criterion: Real week-long kidnapping ends when police kill the captor and free him.
Friends are online gaming friends, concerned by his week of absence and thinking illness; contact follows his return.
He hides the kidnapping to prevent linking his real identity with his online identity, while reassuring them he is fine.

acceptance: All causal narrative elements required, faithful paraphrases accepted. No arbitrary exact wording, names, counts or narrative decoration beyond rubric. Never give solver missing elements. False/incomplete final gets no and game continues.
